annotation.title_clean: Executive Summary of the Impact Assessment: Proposal for a Regulation establishing the Digital Europe programme
annotation.title_en: Executive Summary of the Impact Assessment: Proposal for a Regulation establishing the Digital Europe programme
annotation.summary_en: Executive summary of the Commission's impact assessment for the proposed Digital Europe programme (2021-2027), which aims to close the digital investment gap through five pillars: high-performance computing, AI, cybersecurity and trust, advanced digital skills, and deployment and interoperability. Contains no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Digital Europe Programme proposed within the 2021-2027 multiannual financial framework to bridge the digital investment gap
Five specific objectives: HPC, AI, cybersecurity and trust, advanced digital skills, deployment and interoperability
EU-level intervention justified where funding exceeds what any Member State can provide alone
Progress to be measured with the Digital Economy and Society Index plus new indicators
